name: session-create-needs-v0.5-503
description: A create on a telnet target needs a worker at proto_version 0.5 or later: an older worker has no telnet driver. With no supervisor providing one, the core answers 503 worker_unavailable with a message saying the workers predate telnet, and asks no worker for anything — no create_worker goes out. The live shape is owed by the E3 core plan, which can show that no worker was asked for; the contract's stub provider answers create at 201 and cannot grade this.

error.message: no worker at proto_version 0.5 or later: the workers predate telnet

graded_by.test: owed by the E3 core plan
